fr_html: Le PRESIDENT estime qu'il doit relever cette appréciation trop modeste. Il fait ressortir la grande part qu'a eue Lord Phillimore à la préparation de ce projet; et il ajoute que Lord Phillimore doit assumer également sa part de responsabilité.
en_html: The PRESIDENT felt he should object to this excessive modesty. He pointed out the large part that Lord Phillimore had had in the preparation of this project, and he added that Lord Phillimore ought to take also his share of responsibility.
